"Boston's Archbishop is telling catholics that the church's financial footing is 'much worse than people realize'" is a religion and community story, World (or arguably Business), and nothing in it is Sports.
A Motley Fool column on what happens "anytime a company's founder steps down and moves on", citing Gateway's Ted Waitt and Apple's Steve Jobs, is investing and corporate leadership, Business.

"I.B.M. said that it had agreed to pay $320 million to its employees to settle in part a class-action lawsuit over its pension plan" is a labour and legal settlement with no technology content, Business.

"Nortel Networks said today that after months of trying to untangle faulty financial results, it won't file its 2003 and first-half 2004 results until early next year" is a telecom-equipment company's purely financial story, so Business and Sci/Tech are both defensible.

"Premier Dalton McGuinty ... warning that Ontario will not support efforts to wring billions more in equalization payments" is provincial politics (World) about public finance (Business); both are defensible.

"Shareholders approved Aether Systems Inc.'s sale of one of its two remaining operating divisions ... a deal that will take the Owings Mills company out of the wireless business and nearly complete its transformation into a mortgage investment fund" is a corporate transaction, Business.
"Massachusetts Governor Mitt Romney is calling for the resignation of the head of the state's Turnpike Authority" is state government, World, not Business.

"Iraq's neighbors want tens of billions of dollars for environmental damage done in the 1990-1 Gulf conflict, but are set to get only paltry funds from the United" Nations is war-compensation diplomacy (World) over environmental damage (Sci/Tech); both are defensible.
"Barbara Patten stood next to her Salvation Army kettle and played her flute on a recent Saturday as customers walked past" is a human-interest charity story, World, not Business.

"Video chain Blockbuster Inc on Friday said it would lower the price of its online DVD rentals to undercut a similar move by Netflix Inc. that sparked a ... sell-off of both companies' shares" is a price war (Business) over an online service (Sci/Tech); both are defensible.

"Motorola Inc., the world's No. 2 maker of cell phones, on Tuesday said its quarterly profit more than tripled, as sales rose 26 percent" is a tech company's purely financial story, so Business and Sci/Tech are both defensible.

"Virginia's 10-year experiment with red-light cameras at traffic intersections expires next year, and it is uncertain whether they will be renewed" is state legislation (World) about a surveillance technology (Sci/Tech); both are defensible.

"Public transit in Toronto will not improve next year despite $81-million in provincial gas tax funding announced yesterday, according to Mayor David Miller" is municipal government, World, not Business.

"Agents at the US Secret Service unmasked 28 people who thought they were safe behind anonymous identities and charged them in connection with alleged ID Theft" is a crime bust (World) of an online identity-theft ring (Sci/Tech security); both are defensible.
